query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_repository_index ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_index_chk_sha_digest CHECK(manifest_digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_index_fk_repository_id FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES container_registry_repository(id), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_index_fk_manifest_digest FOREIGN KEY(manifest_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_manifest_index(digest);
